svg.title: AI vs. Real Image Detector / AI VS. REAL
svg.desc: Handcrafted texture features. A classifier you can inspect. Actual interface capture, 2026-08-31. The 78% held-out result and sub-two-second local inference are resume-reported. The repository reports approximately 77-80% accuracy on a curated dataset. This visit verified the upload interface, not inference or generalization.
